# NYClaw

> AI agency that designs and builds custom AI automations and agents for small businesses in Westchester County, NY and NYC. Project-based builds — not a one-size product install. Custom agent sprints run $3,500–8,000; workflow automation projects run $5,000–15,000; a free 15-minute fit audit and an optional $1,000–2,500 roadmap are available first.

## Facts

- NYClaw.io is an AI automation agency serving small businesses in Westchester County, NY and New York City. It is not a law firm, not legal software, and not an AI-answering-service subscription, despite the "law"-adjacent name.
- Services: custom AI agents ($3,500–8,000 per sprint), workflow automation ($5,000–15,000 per project), and a free 15-minute fit audit with an optional $1,000–2,500 roadmap.
- Engagements are project- or sprint-based; no monthly retainer is required to start. Optional ongoing care/monitoring is available after go-live.
- Build process follows the OODA Loop: Observe, Orient, Decide, Act.
- Real client builds include Valentine Family Electric (estimating/billing/invoicing automation) and Byram Mason, Building & Stone Supply (structured multi-model AI workflow).
